Support

Need help with Cast Your Line?

We want the app to feel simple while you are using it and straightforward when something goes wrong. Send us a note and a real person will read it.

We’re here
to help.

Contact support

Email support@quiettoolsapps.com, or use the form below. Include the Mac you are using, your version of macOS, and a short description of the problem when you can.

Thanks. Your support request was sent. We’ll reply as soon as we can.

Use the email address where you want the reply sent.

This form is delivered by email through FormSubmit. Please don’t include passwords or other sensitive information. You can also email support@quiettoolsapps.com directly.

Common topics

We can help with:

  • Getting started without an account
  • Recording trips
  • Logging catches
  • Photos and notes
  • Saved locations
  • GPS route tracking
  • Trip history, Explore, and the calendar
  • Weather
  • Yearly and monthly recaps
  • Photo books
  • Data and privacy
  • iCloud sync
  • Purchases
  • App settings

Helpful details to include

  • Your Mac model and macOS version
  • The version of Cast Your Line you are using
  • What you expected to happen and what happened instead
  • Steps that reproduce the problem, if you can find them
